headline: Large catalogues and modular decompositions map microbial mobile and accessory gene content
label: Microbial Mobilome And Pangenome Catalogues
summary: New resources span a planetary MGE catalogue, a population-scale gut phage catalogue, and modular decomposition of the S. aureus accessory pangenome.
synthesis: The dominant thread is structured cataloguing of variable microbial gene content (mobile elements, phages and accessory genes) at scales that support downstream association analyses. proMGE2 catalogues over 16.4 million mobile genetic elements from isolate genomes and MAGs across habitats, with a 5-million-sequence non-redundant set. A metagenomic analysis of 1,069 TwinsUK gut samples builds a 116,740-vOTU phage catalogue and links phage genomic variation to bacterial species and microbial metabolites. PHI packages prophage identification, quality assessment, host prediction and functional annotation in a Galaxy workflow with standardized reporting. On the pangenome side, non-negative matrix factorization of 1,398 S. aureus genomes resolves the accessory genome into 24 additive gene modules that separate lineage from adaptation and virulence. ETEC work examines how plasmid-host associations shape colonization-factor distribution. Peripheral items include deep learning-guided discovery of over 46,000 putative environmental beta-lactamases from metagenomes. They also include genome-scale metabolic models of 105 C. difficile strains, in which diet outweighs strain differences in shaping commensal interactions.
